dz: 迈克尔一世·科姆内诺斯·杜卡斯是伊庇鲁斯专制统治的第一任统治者,他与威尼斯共和国签订条约并成为他们的巫师.
de: Michael I Komnenos Doukas, the first ruler of the despotate of Epirus, signs a treaty with the Republic of Venice and becomes their vassal.

de: Maria of Montferrat, Queen of Jerusalem, marries French baron John of Brienne, who is later crowned king on 30 October in Tyre.

dz: 教宗英诺森特三世在答应承认教宗对西西里王国的控制后,将神圣罗马皇帝奥托四世驱逐出入侵西西里王国.
de: Pope Innocent III excommunicates Holy Roman Emperor Otto IV for invading the Kingdom of Sicily after promising to recognize papal control over it.

te: The Castle of Termes falls to Simon de Montfort after a four-month siege during the Albigensian Crusade.
dz: 在阿尔比根斯十字军东征期间被围攻了四个月后,特尔梅斯城堡倒向了西蒙·德·蒙福特.
